sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface imaging in neurons confirmed the Myc-tagged construct reaches the cell surface and co-localizes with AMPA receptor subunits GluA1 and GluA4; barrier/channel function of Cldn24 itself was NOT MEASURED.
sites.rationale: L1 and L2 both report the same construct, Cldn24(Myc-ex), a full-length membrane-anchored claudin-24 with a Myc tag inserted into 'the extracellular loop'; the construct name suffix '-ex' explicitly denotes extracellular placement, and its use in live-cell surface imaging confirms the tag is accessible on the extracellular face. CLDN24 has two extracellular loops (ECL1: residues 31-81, 51 aa; ECL2: residues 139-163, 25 aa); the paper names neither specifically, so no residue can be pinned and insert_after_residue is left null with region set to 'extracellular loop' as stated. The V5-tagged construct (L3/L4) has no stated position and was used only for co-IP, so it does not qualify as a surface site. Full-length Cldn24(Myc-ex) construct expressed in primary hippocampal neurons by co-transfection with GluA1(HA-ex)/GluA4(HA-ex) and Homer-1c-EGFP; the '-ex' suffix denotes extracellular tag placement; used for co-localization imaging at the neuronal surface.

sources.claim: After 5 days in vitro, neurons were cotransfected with the following plasmids: GluA1(HA-ex)/pMH4, Cldn24(Myc-ex)/pMH4, and Homer-1c-EGFP/pcDNA3.1 using Lipofectamine 2000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

literature_notes: L1 and L2 are treated as a single site because they describe the same construct (Cldn24(Myc-ex)) from the same paper. The paper states the Myc tag is in 'the extracellular loop' but does not specify ECL1 (31-81) or ECL2 (139-163), nor any residue; accordingly insert_after_residue is null and region is set to 'extracellular loop' as stated. The V5-tagged Cldn24 (L3/L4) has a completely unstated tag position and was used only for co-immunoprecipitation, not surface detection; it cannot be classified as a surface site and is excluded from sites. Both termini of CLDN24 are intracellular (N-terminus IC1: 1-11; C-terminus IC3: 185-220), so no terminal extracellular site exists. ECL1 contains two conserved cysteines (C54, C64) that likely form a disulfide bond critical to claudin fold; any internal site within ECL1 would need to avoid these. ECL2 (25 aa) is shorter and also functionally important in claudin family members.
